THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
162
STUDY 126
Red Velvet Hoodie & Space Buns
Rights check / Repeats Study 113.
Source: 25006.jpg
Nostalgic, moody, retro
WORKING NOTES
- Keep only one of sections 113 or 126 if you do not need
both.
- The space buns and red velvet are the defining elements.
Try this: Emphasize the space buns and red velvet.
IMAGE PROMPT
This is a duplicate of section 113, kept
for reference. An original young woman
with blonde hair in two high space buns
wears small wire sunglasses and a red
velvet zip hoodie over a burgundy
turtleneck. A thin silver necklace sits at
her throat, and a patterned quilted bag
rests on her shoulder. Her expression is
calm and direct. A blurred night street
with soft city lights behind her. Palette of
crimson, burgundy, and midnight blue.
Nostalgic and moody, in the style of a
late-1990s film still.
